name: english_plural
description: Produce the plural form of an English noun using regular and irregular morphology; matched control repeats the singular noun.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
regular='cat dog book tree car bird house chair table flower cup phone computer bottle window robot teacher student doctor artist'.split()
es='box fox bus dish church watch brush class'.split()
y='city baby story party lady family country cherry'.split()
irregular=dict(zip('child man woman tooth foot mouse goose person'.split(),'children men women teeth feet mice geese people'.split()))
pairs=[(n,n+'s') for n in regular]+[(n,n+'es') for n in es]+[(n,n[:-1]+'ies') for n in y]+list(irregular.items())
items=[];control=[]
for rep in range(2):
 for n,p in pairs:
  items.append({'prompt':f'Write the English plural of this noun.\nSingular: {n}\nPlural:', 'answer':' '+p})
  control.append({'prompt':f'Repeat this English noun unchanged.\nSingular: {n}\nCopy:', 'answer':' '+n})
random.shuffle(items);random.shuffle(control)
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
